# Morphometic analysis
```{r, label="import spores",results="hide", echo=F, cache=T, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Import outlines: First list jpeg files to import
# Load your files
eco <- read_csv("Results/Ecology/Ecology_from_tree.csv") %>%
  mutate(species = tolower(species))

pca <- read_csv("Results/PCA/PCA_Spore_Scores_Aggregated_with_Count.csv") %>%
  mutate(species = tolower(species))

vol <- read_csv("Results/Volume/Volume.csv") %>%
  mutate(species = tolower(species))

loc <- read_csv("Results/Weather/Location_Date_Precipitation_monthly_cm.csv") %>%
  mutate(species = tolower(species))

clim <- read.csv("Results/Climate/Amanita_Climate_Summary.csv") %>%
  mutate(species = tolower(species))

# Merge all
df <- pca %>% left_join(vol, by = "species") %>% left_join(eco, by = "species") %>%
  left_join(loc, by = "species") %>%
  left_join(clim, by = "species")

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    log_precip = log10(Precipitation_monthly_cm + 1e-6),  # small constant to avoid log(0)
    log_volume = log10(avg_volume_estimated)
  )

```


```{r}

# ============================================================
# Compare combined models for precipitation
# ============================================================

# ---- Step 1: Fit three models ----
model_pc1   <- lm(log_precip ~ PC1_mean, data = df)
model_vol   <- lm(log_precip ~ log_volume, data = df)
model_comb  <- lm(log_precip ~ PC1_mean + log_volume, data = df)

# ---- Step 2: Summarize key metrics ----
summaries <- tibble(
  Model = c("PC1 only", "Volume only", "Combined"),
  Formula = c("log_precip ~ PC1_mean", 
              "log_precip ~ log_volume", 
              "log_precip ~ PC1_mean + log_volume"),
  R2 = c(summary(model_pc1)$r.squared,
         summary(model_vol)$r.squared,
         summary(model_comb)$r.squared),
  Adjusted_R2 = c(summary(model_pc1)$adj.r.squared,
                  summary(model_vol)$adj.r.squared,
                  summary(model_comb)$adj.r.squared),
  AIC = c(AIC(model_pc1),
          AIC(model_vol),
          AIC(model_comb))
)

# Compute delta AIC (difference from best model)
summaries <- summaries %>%
  mutate(Delta_AIC = round(AIC - min(AIC), 2))

# ---- Step 3: Output clean summary ----
cat("### Model Comparison: PC1, Volume, and Combined\n\n")
cat("**Dependent variable:** log(Precipitation)**\n\n")
knitr::kable(summaries, digits = 3, align = "c")

# ---- Step 4: Save to CSV ----
if(!dir.exists("Results/Stats")) dir.create("Results/Stats", recursive = TRUE)
write_csv(summaries, "Results/Stats/Model_Comparison_PC1_Volume_vs_Precip.csv")

cat("\n✅ Model comparison table saved to:\n")
cat("- Results/Stats/Model_Comparison_PC1_Volume_vs_Precip.csv\n\n")
```
